Moderator strategy review
Strategy reviewThe Village won 2 to 0 against a strong Yakuza team of four (Carol, Erin, Ivan, Mallory) that also had a Fixer, a Ballot Stuffer and Katana Master. The town won by stacking visit results and vote totals. **Day 2:** The town hanged Olivia, who was the Executioner. She lied that her target was Dave (it was Heidi). Her trial still gave the town its first real clue. Dave and Judy each said in public that they would vote Innocent as Remorseful insurance. Dave's Faultline trait then showed that Erin's vote had counted Innocent even though she said Guilty. That was her Merciful trait, and Dave put it in his will. **Night 2:** Carol used Katana Master to kill Dave. Judy was watching Dave and saw Carol and Frank visit him. **Day 3:** Frank's Trapper claim was backed by Heidi's Insomniac results, so Carol was the only unexplained visitor. Carol made the biggest Yakuza mistake of the game: - She sent public-ledger private messages to Ivan, Mallory and Niaj. - She persuaded Ivan and Mallory to click Innocent while saying Guilty. - Together with Erin's Merciful vote, the fix on Frank, Carol's doubled ballot and Judy's misclick, the trial came out 4 Guilty, 7 Innocent with 11 votes counted. - That total exposed a hidden voting bloc. Bob then used his Sniper token on Carol and killed her. Mallory, whose only claim was a Profiler who "held" her N2 token, was hanged 5 to 4. **Night 3:** Niaj's Stolen Blade on Erin was absorbed by Narrow Escape. Erin killed Bob, and Bob's Cursed trait killed Frank, which proved Frank was Good. Judy saw Alice and Erin visit Bob. Alice spent her Seer token on Bob and Ivan and got DIFFERENT. **Day 4:** Erin's last fix on Heidi produced two 3 to 3 trials. The town correctly stopped instead of burning a third trial. **Night 4 and Day 5:** Erin killed Heidi. Judy was watching Alice and saw no visitors. Combined with Niaj's Scout groups, that showed Alice did not visit Heidi, so Erin was hanged on Day 5. Ivan's made-up Oracle result ("Alice = Seer, wrong") fell apart, because Judy had seen Alice really visit someone and a Roleplayer's actions are not visits. **Night 5 and Day 6:** Ivan killed Alice while Judy watched her. On Day 6 he claimed Notorious and then Sleepwalker, both at the last minute, and was hanged. **What decided it:** Judy's choice of whom to watch each night, the public vote tallies checked against trait results, Bob's well-timed shot, and the Yakuza's hidden Innocent votes and visible private messages.

Outside log review (rules and bugs)
Review: medium, harness bugDay 3, Carol's trial: Judy said publicly she was voting Guilty, but the secret ballot recorded her as Innocent. Judy then filed feedback that 'the interface may have recorded it wrong.' The only player fixed that Day was Frank, so a fix doesn't explain it. It was either a real player misclick or an interface bug in recording trial votes; this should be checked. It shaped much of the town's Day 3 vote math.
Review: medium, rules ambiguityThe Paranoid trait says the player is 'told you were attacked and survived', but R3 says survivors learn the attacking role, and the trait never says which role a fake attack names. On Night 1 the moderator chose 'Katana' for Bob's fake attack. The town then decided two Katana attacks happened and a Spare or Stolen Blade was in play, and that idea ran through several Days. The rules should say what role (if any) the fake attack names.
Review: low, prompt problemSetup logged '[ERROR tips_stale] tips/tips.md was last checked against an older version of the rules', and these tips went to all 13 players. Players may have been given advice that no longer matches the current rules.
Review: low, harness bugThe [Moderator summary] for Nights 1, 3 and 5 was posted twice, with slightly different wording each time. It doesn't affect play but clutters the log.
Game over
WinnersAlice, Bob, Dave, Frank, Grace, Heidi, Judy, Niaj
